scope: three fixed rogue6 received-healing/HP-recovery sources; parameter composition only

mechanism_facts.fact: Each selected relic has three global_buff_normal records; current GBuffNormal.Preprocess allocates an independent GlobalBuffData with a copied Blackboard and appends it. No stack preprocessor is used.
BattleController._CreateAndInitGlobalBuffs creates each listed prefab and calls virtual slot12=GlobalBuff.OnInit. Modifier Blackboards are assigned per global object.

All three actual receiving-healing/recovery prefabs have empty global key and child disableOverride=1. BuffData.GetOverrideKey returns String.Empty; BuffContainer.NewBuff enables the child directly rather than entering EnsureOverrideGroup. Thus equal child keys do not collapse these sources.

Actual heal_scale template event6 (ON_APPLYING_MODIFIER) is IsHeal then ModifierScaleUp. Current ModifierScaleUp.Execute on healing reads heal_scale, then multiplies current modifier.value by its own Blackboard factor and writes it back; distinct enabled sources multiply successively.

Flat HP recovery prefab uses attribute13; max-HP-ratio recovery uses attribute19; both are formulaItem1 (MULTIPLIER), loadFromBlackboard=1. Current Attributes._CalculateAttributeValue sums the MULTIPLIER terms before applying 1+sum, so20%+30%+40%=90%extra to both channels. Each source is counted once per channel, not twice.
